patch_description: This hybrid keeps the current program’s successful lower-tail annealing objective and active-triple targeting, while incorporating the inspiration program’s barycentric perturbations, elite-basin retention, and simplex-direction polishing. Barycentric proposals give better boundary-safe exploration than clipping Cartesian simplex coordinates. The implementation also caches the current tail energy instead of recomputing it before every proposal and retains several terminal basins for deterministic local refinement, improving robustness without changing the function interface or returned Cartesian coordinate format.
